questions.solution_en:

(sec x. sec y + tan x.tan y)² – (sec x.tan y + tan x.sec y)²

= sec²x.sec²y + tan²x.tan²y + 2sec x.sec y.tan x.tan y – sec²x.tan²y – tan²x.sec²y – 2sec x.sec y.tan x.tan y

= sec²x.sec²y + tan²x.tan²y – sec²x.tan²y – tan²x.sec²y

= sec²x.sec²y – sec²x.tan²y –  tan²x.sec²y + tan²x.tan²y 

= sec²x(sec²y – tan²y) – tan²x(sec²y – tan²y)

= sec²x – tan²x = 1

questions.q_en: 5. A circular wire of diameter 42 cm is folded in the shape of a rectangle whose sides are in the ratio 6 : 5. Find the area enclosed by the rectangle.(π = 227)
questions.q_hi: 5. एक गोलाकार तार जिसका व्यास 42 सेमी है, को मोड़ कर एक आयत में ढाला गया है, जिसकी भुजाओ का अनुपात 6 : 5 हैं | आयत के द्वारा घेरे गए क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है।(π = 227)
questions.solution_en:
5.(b)

Radius of circular wire = 422 = 21cm ;

Circumference of wire = 2πr

= 2 × 227 × 21 = 132 cm;

Let the length and breadth of rectangle be 6x and 5x cm respectively;

∴ perimeter of rectangle = 2(6x + 5x) = 22x;

According to the question, 22x = 132;

⟶ x = 13222 = 6;

∴ Length of rectangle = 6x = 6 × 6 = 36cm;

Breadth of rectangle = 5x = 5 × 6 = 30cm;

∴ Area = 36 × 30 = 1080 cm²
questions.solution_hi:
5.(b)

वृत्ताकार तार की त्रिज्या = 422 = 21 cm;

तार की परिधि = 2πr

= 2 × 227 × 21 = 132 cm;

माना आयत की लंबाई और चौड़ाई क्रमशः 6x और 5x cm है;

∴ आयत का परिमाप = 2(6x + 5x) = 22x;

प्रश्न के अनुसार, 22x = 132;

⟶ x = 13222 = 6

∴ आयत की लंबाई = 6x = 6 × 6 = 36 cm

आयत की चौड़ाई = 5x = 5 × 6 = 30 cm

∴ क्षेत्रफल = 36 × 30 = 1080 cm²

∴ Remaining milk = 92 – 925 = 460 - 925 = 3685

= 115 - 23 + 1355 = 2275 litres

∴ Required ratio = 3685 : 2275 = 368 : 227

questions.q_en: 26. The average of 14 numbers is 50.The average of the first four numbers is 40 and that of the next seven numbers is 50. The 12th number is two times the 13th number which is 4 less than the 14th number. What is the average of the 12th and 14th numbers?

questions.solution_en:
26.(a)

Sum of 14 numbers = 14 × 50 = 700

Sum of first four numbers = 4 × 40 = 160

Sum of next seven numbers = 7 × 50 = 350

Then sum of 12th, 13th and 14th number = 700 - 160 - 350 = 190

Let 14th number = x

And 12th number = 2(x - 4)

⇒ 2(x - 4) + (x - 4) + x = 190

 ⇒ 2x - 8 + x - 4 + x = 190

⇒ 4x =190 + 12   

 ⇒ x = 50.5

Then 12th number = 2(50.5 - 4) = 93

14th number = 50.5

 ⇒  Required average =  93 + 50.52 = 71.75

27.(a)

Let the savings of the person be 3 units

352 = 3x + 300

8 × 44% = 3 × (x)% + 5 × 60%

questions.solution_en:
28.(b)

As BQ = PQ, ∠BPQ = ∠ PBQ = x,

As QC = QR, ∠QRC = ∠QCR = y,

In triangle ABC, 75 + x + y = 180.

x + y = 105

2(x + y) + ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 360

210 + ∠PQB + ∠RQC = 360

∠PQB + ∠RQC = 150.

Now as BC is a straight line,

∠PQB + ∠RQC + ∠PQR = 180

∠PQR = 180 - 150 = 30°
